title: Letter of Dakhamunzu and the death of Suppiluliuma I
summary: An Egyptian queen (Dakhamunzu) writes to the Hittite king Suppiluliuma I asking for a son to marry; Suppiluliuma dies soon afterwards.
description: An Egyptian queen (Dakhamunzu) writes to the Hittite king Suppiluliuma I asking for a son to marry; Suppiluliuma dies soon afterwards. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.
